mapper.select: SELECT id, task_id AS taskId, pro_id AS proId, pro_sub_type AS proSubType, expert_uid AS expertUid, audit_opinion AS auditOpinion, main_review_text AS mainReviewText, main_review_submitted AS mainReviewSubmitted, created, updated FROM ass_surver_expert_review_opinion WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND pro_id = #{proId} AND expert_uid = #{expertUid} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, task_id AS taskId, pro_id AS proId, pro_sub_type AS proSubType, expert_uid AS expertUid, audit_opinion AS auditOpinion, main_review_text AS mainReviewText, main_review_submitted AS mainReviewSubmitted, created, updated FROM ass_surver_expert_review_opinion WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND expert_uid = #{expertUid} ORDER BY pro_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ass_surver_expert_review_opinion SET main_review_text = #{mainReviewText}, main_review_submitted = #{mainReviewSubmitted}, updated = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ass_award_enterprise_project pro JOIN ass_award_pro_expert_group peg ON peg.proid = pro.id JOIN ass_award_expert_group eg ON eg.groupid = peg.groupid AND eg.taskid = peg.taskid JOIN add_special_info si ON si.group_name = eg.name AND si.user_id = #{expertUid} AND si.pro_type = 'surver_pro_group' AND si.deleted = 0 WHERE pro.pro_type = 'surver_pro' AND pro.publish_task_id = #{taskId} AND pro.id = #{proId}
